names: Daughter of the King of Goryeo

label.en: Guardian of the Heir Apparent Grand Tutor
tribal chief lingwen of the department
great xianwen of the Sanhe Wugu tribe
Great King of the Northern Court
military governor of Wei, Bo, and other prefectures
Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat

expression.en: died after a meteor fell in his courtyard

label.en: Hanlin commissioner and Minister of Personnel

units.zh: 耶律解裏耶律拔裏得耶律朔古耶律魯不古趙延壽高模翰趙思溫耶律漚裏思張礪
units.en: Yelu Jieli, Yelu Balide, Yelu Shuogu, Yelu Lubugu, Zhao Yanshou, Gao Mohan, Zhao Siwen, Yelu Oulisi, and Zhang Li
units.literal: Yelu Jieli, Yelu Balide, Yelu Shuogu, Yelu Lubugu, Zhao Yanshou, Gao Mohan, Zhao Siwen, Yelu Oulisi, Zhang Li

units.zh: 耶律解裏，字潑單，突呂不部人，世為小吏。
units.en: Yelu Jieli, whose courtesy name was Podan, came from the Tülübu tribe; his family had served as petty clerks for generations.
units.literal: Yelu Jieli, courtesy name Podan, was a man of the Tülübu tribe; for generations his family had served as petty clerks.

units.zh: 解裏早隸太宗麾下，擢為軍校。
units.en: Jieli entered Emperor Taizong's service while still young and was promoted to army cadet.
units.literal: Jieli entered Taizong's service early and was promoted to army cadet.

units.zh: 天顯間，唐攻定州，既陷，解裏為唐兵所獲。
units.en: During the Tianxian era, when Tang attacked Dingzhou and took it, Jieli was captured by the Tang army.
units.literal: During the Tianxian era Tang attacked Dingzhou; after it fell, Jieli was captured by Tang troops.

units.zh: 晉高祖立，始歸國。
units.en: Only when Emperor Gaozu of Later Jin took the throne did he return home.
units.literal: When Emperor Gaozu of Jin ascended, he at last returned to his state.

units.zh: 太宗貰其罪，拜御史大夫。
units.en: Emperor Taizong pardoned his offense and appointed him Grand Censor.
units.literal: Taizong remitted his offense and appointed him Grand Censor.

units.zh: 會同九年伐晉，師次滹沱河，奪中渡橋，降其將杜重威。
units.en: In the ninth year of Huitong, when the army marched against Jin, it halted at the Hutuo River, seized the Zhongdu Bridge, and forced the Jin general Du Chongwei to surrender.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Huitong they campaigned against Jin; the army halted at the Hutuo River, seized the Zhongdu Bridge, and compelled the surrender of the Jin general Du Chongwei.

units.zh: 上命解裏與降將張彥澤率騎兵三千疾趨河南，所至無敢當其鋒。
units.en: The emperor ordered Jieli and the surrendered general Zhang Yanze to lead three thousand horsemen in a swift drive into Henan; nowhere they went did anyone dare stand against their charge.
units.literal: The sovereign ordered Jieli and the surrendered general Zhang Yanze to lead three thousand cavalry in a rapid advance into Henan; wherever they went none dared confront their edge.

units.zh: 既入汴，解裏等遷晉主重貴於開封府。
units.en: Once they had entered Bian, Jieli and his party relocated the Jin emperor Chonggui to Kaifeng prefecture.
units.literal: After entering Bian, Jieli and the others moved the Jin sovereign Chonggui to Kaifeng prefecture.

units.zh: 彥澤恣殺掠，亂宮掖，解裏不能禁，百姓騷然，莫不怨憤。
units.en: Yanze killed and plundered at will and threw the inner palace into chaos; Jieli could not stop him, the people were in an uproar, and everyone seethed with resentment.
units.literal: Yanze wantonly killed and plundered and threw the palace quarters into disorder; Jieli could not restrain him, the common people were in uproar, and none did not resent it in fury.

units.zh: 車駕至京，數彥澤罪，斬於市，汴人大悅。
units.en: When the emperor reached the capital, he recounted Yanze's crimes and had him beheaded in the marketplace, to the great joy of the people of Bian.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage reached the capital, the emperor enumerated Yanze's crimes and executed him in the marketplace; the people of Bian were greatly pleased.

units.zh: 解裏亦被詰責，尋釋之。
units.en: Jieli was questioned and rebuked as well, but was soon released.
units.literal: Jieli was also interrogated and rebuked, but was released shortly thereafter.

units.zh: 天祿間，加守太子太傅。
units.en: During the Tianlu era he was further appointed Guardian of the Heir Apparent Grand Tutor.
units.literal: During the Tianlu era he was additionally made Guardian of the Heir Apparent Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 應歷初，置本部令穩，解裏世其職，卒。
units.en: At the start of the Yingli era the post of tribal chief wen of the department was created; Jieli held it as a hereditary office in his line and then died.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yingli the post of tribal chief wen of the department was established; Jieli inherited the office in his family line and died.

units.zh: 耶律拔裏得，字孩鄰，太祖弟剌葛之子。
units.en: Yelu Balide, whose courtesy name was Hailin, was the son of Chige, a younger brother of Emperor Taizu.
units.literal: Yelu Balide, courtesy name Hailin, was a son of Chige, younger brother of Taizu.

units.zh: 太宗即位，以親愛見任。
units.en: When Taizong came to the throne, Balide was placed in office on account of their close kinship and affection.
units.literal: When Taizong took the throne, Balide was entrusted because of close affection.

units.zh: 會同七年，討石重貴，拔裏得進圍德州，下之，擒刺史師居璠等二十七人。
units.en: In the seventh year of Huitong, during the campaign against Shi Chonggui, Balide advanced to besiege Dezhou, captured the city, and took the prefect Shi Jufan and twenty-seven others prisoner.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Huitong, when they campaigned against Shi Chonggui, Balide advanced to besiege Dezhou, took it, and captured the prefect Shi Jufan and twenty-seven others.

units.zh: 九年，再舉兵，次滹沱河，降杜重威，戰功居多。
units.en: In the ninth year the army marched again, camped at the Hutuo River, and forced Du Chongwei to surrender; Balide's share of the fighting was the greatest of all.
units.literal: In the ninth year they raised arms again, halted at the Hutuo River, and compelled Du Chongwei to surrender; Balide's battle achievements were foremost among the generals.

units.zh: 太宗入汴，以功授安國軍節度使，總領河北道事。
units.en: When Taizong entered Bian, Balide was appointed military governor of the Anguo army for his achievements and put in overall charge of the Hebei circuit.
units.literal: When Taizong entered Bian, Balide was made military governor of Anguo army for his merit and given overall charge of affairs on the Hebei circuit.

units.zh: 師還，州郡往往叛，以應劉知遠，拔裏得不能守而歸。
units.en: After the army withdrew, prefectures and districts rose in revolt one after another to rally to Liu Zhiyuan; Balide could not hold the territory and came back.
units.literal: When the army withdrew, prefectures and districts often rebelled to answer Liu Zhiyuan; Balide could not hold his post and returned.

units.zh: 世宗即位，遷中京留守，卒。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong came to the throne, Balide was moved to regent of the Central Capital, where he died.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, Balide was transferred to be regent of the Central Capital and died.

units.zh: 耶律朔古，字彌骨頂，橫帳孟父之後。
units.en: Yelu Shuogu, whose courtesy name was Miguding, came from the Horizontal Tent Mengfu line.
units.literal: Yelu Shuogu, courtesy name Miguding, was of the Horizontal Tent Mengfu line.

units.zh: 幼為太祖所養。
units.en: From childhood he was raised by Emperor Taizu.
units.literal: From childhood he was raised by Taizu.

units.zh: 既冠，為右皮室詳穩。
units.en: After reaching adulthood he was appointed right pishi xianwen.
units.literal: After coming of age he was made right pishi xianwen.

units.zh: 從伐渤海，戰有功。
units.en: He took part in campaigns against Bohai and distinguished himself in battle.
units.literal: He followed campaigns against Bohai and rendered merit in battle.

units.zh: 天顯七年，授三河烏古部都詳穩。
units.en: In the seventh year of Tianxian he was made great xianwen of the Sanhe Wugu tribe.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Tianxian he was appointed great xianwen of the Sanhe Wugu tribe.

units.zh: 平易近民，民安之，以故久其任。
units.en: Plain and approachable with the people, he kept them at ease, and for that reason he held the post for a long time.
units.literal: He was close to the people and easy in manner; the people were content, and for that reason he long held the post.

units.zh: 會同間，為惕隱。
units.en: During the Huitong period he held the office of tiyin.
units.literal: During the Huitong era he served as tiyin.

units.zh: 時晉主石重貴渝盟，帝親征，晉將杜重威擁眾拒滹沱。
units.en: When the Jin emperor Shi Chonggui broke the alliance, the emperor marched in person; the Jin general Du Chongwei massed his troops to block the army at the Hutuo.
units.literal: When the Jin sovereign Shi Chonggui broke the alliance, the emperor campaigned in person; the Jin general Du Chongwei gathered his force to oppose him at the Hutuo.

units.zh: 月餘，帝由他渡濟。
units.en: After more than a month the emperor crossed at another ford.
units.literal: After more than a month the emperor crossed by another ford.

units.zh: 朔古與趙延壽據中渡橋，重威兵卻，遂降。
units.en: Shuogu and Zhao Yanshou held the Zhongdu Bridge; Chongwei's army fell back and he surrendered.
units.literal: Shuogu and Zhao Yanshou held the Zhongdu Bridge; Chongwei's troops gave way and he surrendered.

units.zh: 是歲，入汴。
units.en: That year the army entered Bian.
units.literal: That year they entered Bian.

units.zh: 世宗即位，朔古奉太宗喪歸上京，佐皇太后出師，坐是免官，卒。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong came to the throne, Shuogu escorted Emperor Taizong's coffin back to the Supreme Capital and aided the empress dowager in taking the field; for this he was stripped of office and died.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, Shuogu escorted Taizong's coffin back to the Supreme Capital and assisted the empress dowager in leading troops; for this he was dismissed from office and died.

units.zh: 耶律魯不古，字信寧，太祖從侄也。
units.en: Yelu Lubugu, whose courtesy name was Xinning, was a paternal cousin of Emperor Taizu.
units.literal: Yelu Lubugu, courtesy name Xinning, was a younger cousin of Taizu on the father's side.

units.zh: 初，太祖制契丹國字，魯不古以贊成功，授林牙、監修國史。
units.en: When Taizu first devised the Khitan national script, Lubugu helped bring the project to completion and was appointed linya and supervisor of the national history.
units.literal: At first, when Taizu devised the Khitan national script, Lubugu assisted in completing the work and was appointed linya and supervisor of compiling the national history.

units.zh: 後率偏師，為西南邊大詳穩，從伐党項有功。
units.en: Later he led a detached force, became great xianwen on the southwestern frontier, and distinguished himself in campaigns against the Tangut.
units.literal: Later he led a detached column, served as great xianwen of the southwestern frontier, and rendered merit in campaigns against the Tangut.

units.zh: 會河東節度使石敬瑭為其主所討，遣人求援，魯不古導送於朝，如其請。
units.en: When the Hedong military governor Shi Jingtang was attacked by his own ruler and sent envoys to seek help, Lubugu escorted them to court and the plea was granted as requested.
units.literal: When Hedong military governor Shi Jingtang was attacked by his sovereign and sent men to seek aid, Lubugu guided the envoys to court and the request was granted as he asked.

units.zh: 帝親率師往援，魯不古從擊唐將張敬達於太原北，敗之。
units.en: The emperor led the army in person to relieve him; Lubugu joined the attack on the Tang general Zhang Jingda north of Taiyuan and routed him.
units.literal: The emperor personally led the army to the rescue; Lubugu followed and struck the Tang general Zhang Jingda north of Taiyuan and defeated him.

units.zh: 會同初，從討党項，俘獲最諸將，師還。
units.en: Early in the Huitong era he took part in the campaign against the Tangut; among the generals his haul of prisoners was the greatest, and then the army returned.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huitong he followed the campaign against the Tangut; his captives were the most among the generals, and the army returned.

units.zh: 天祿中，拜於越。
units.en: During the Tianlu era he was made yuyue.
units.literal: During the Tianlu era he was appointed yuyue.

units.zh: 六年，為北院大王。
units.en: In the sixth year he became Great King of the Northern Court.
units.literal: In the sixth year he became Great King of the Northern Court.

units.zh: 終年五十五。
units.en: He died at the age of fifty-five.
units.literal: He died at the age of fifty-five.

units.zh: 趙延壽，本姓劉，恒山人。
units.en: Zhao Yanshou, whose original surname was Liu, came from Hengshan.
units.literal: Zhao Yanshou, original surname Liu, was a man of Hengshan.

units.zh: 父邟，令蓚。
units.en: His father Kuai had been magistrate of Tiao.
units.literal: His father Kuai was magistrate of Tiao.

units.zh: 梁開平初，滄州節度使劉守文陷蓚，其稗將趙德鈞獲延壽，養以為子。
units.en: Early in the Liang Kaiping era, when Cangzhou military governor Liu Shouwen seized Shuo, his lieutenant Zhao Dejun captured Yanshou and adopted him as a son.
units.literal: At the beginning of Kaiping of Liang, Cangzhou military governor Liu Shouwen took Shuo; his subordinate general Zhao Dejun captured Yanshou and raised him as a son.

units.zh: 少美容貌，好書史。
units.en: As a youth he was handsome and loved books and history.
units.literal: In youth he was handsome in appearance and fond of books and history.

units.zh: 唐明宗先以女妻之，及即位，封其女為興平公主，拜延壽駙馬都尉、樞密使。
units.en: Emperor Mingzong of Tang had already married a daughter to him; when he came to the throne he enfeoffed her as Princess of Xingping and appointed Yanshou imperial son-in-law commandant and commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: Tang Emperor Mingzong had first given him a daughter in marriage; when he took the throne he enfeoffed the daughter as Princess of Xingping and appointed Yanshou imperial son-in-law commandant and commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 明宗子從榮恃權跋扈，內外莫不震懾，延壽求補外避之，出為宣武軍節度使。
units.en: Mingzong's son Congrong wielded power arrogantly, and everyone inside and outside the court trembled before him; Yanshou asked for a provincial post to keep clear of him and was sent out as military governor of the Xuanwu army.
units.literal: Mingzong's son Congrong relied on power and was overbearing; within and without none were not awed in fear; Yanshou sought an outside appointment to avoid him and went out as military governor of the Xuanwu army.

units.zh: 清泰初，加魯國公，復為樞密使，鎮許州。
units.en: Early in the Qingtai era he was made Duke of Lu, again became commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and took charge at Xu Prefecture.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingtai he was made Duke of Lu, again became commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and garrisoned Xuzhou.

units.zh: 石敬瑭發兵太原，唐遣張敬達往討。
units.en: When Shi Jingtang raised an army at Taiyuan, Tang dispatched Zhang Jingda to suppress him.
units.literal: Shi Jingtang raised troops at Taiyuan; Tang sent Zhang Jingda to attack him.

units.zh: 會敬達敗保晉安寨，延壽與德鈞往救，聞晉安已破，走團柏峪。
units.en: When Jingda was beaten back and held Jin'an stockade, Yanshou and Dejun marched to relieve him; learning that Jin'an had already fallen, they fled to Tuanbai Valley.
units.literal: When Jingda was defeated and held Jin'an stockade, Yanshou and Dejun went to the rescue; hearing that Jin'an had already fallen, they fled to Tuanbai Valley.

units.zh: 太宗追及，延壽與其父俱降。
units.en: Taizong caught up with them, and Yanshou and his father both surrendered.
units.literal: Taizong overtook them; Yanshou and his father both surrendered.

units.zh: 明年，德鈞卒，以延壽為幽州節度使，封燕王。
units.en: The following year Dejun died; Yanshou was appointed military governor of Youzhou and enfeoffed as King of Yan.
units.literal: The next year Dejun died; Yanshou was made military governor of Youzhou and enfeoffed as King of Yan.

units.zh: 及改幽州為南京，遷留守，總山南事。
units.en: When Youzhou was redesignated the Southern Capital, he was moved to regent there with overall authority over affairs south of the mountains.
units.literal: When Youzhou was renamed the Southern Capital, he was transferred to be regent there and given overall charge of affairs south of the mountains.

units.zh: 天顯末，以延壽妻在晉，詔取之以歸。
units.en: Late in the Tianxian era, because Yanshou's wife was still in Jin territory, an edict was issued to fetch her and bring her home.
units.literal: At the end of Tianxian, because Yanshou's wife was in Jin, an edict ordered that she be brought back.

units.zh: 自是益自激昂圖報。
units.en: From that time on he burned all the more fiercely to repay the favor.
units.literal: From then on he became all the more ardent in plotting repayment.

units.zh: 會同初，帝幸其第，加政事令。
units.en: Early in the Huitong era the emperor visited his home and further appointed him chief of governmental affairs.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huitong the emperor visited his residence and additionally made him chief of governmental affairs.

units.zh: 六年冬，晉人背盟，帝親征，延壽為先鋒，下貝州，授魏、博等州節度使，封魏王。
units.en: In the winter of the sixth year, when Jin broke the alliance, the emperor marched in person with Yanshou as vanguard; he captured Beizhou, was appointed military governor of Wei, Bo, and other prefectures, and was enfeoffed as King of Wei.
units.literal: In the winter of the sixth year the Jin broke the covenant; the emperor campaigned in person, Yanshou served as vanguard, took Beizhou, was made military governor of Wei, Bo, and other prefectures, and enfeoffed as King of Wei.

units.zh: 敗晉軍於南樂，獲其將賽項羽。
units.en: He routed the Jin army at Nanle and took their general Sai Xiangyu prisoner.
units.literal: He defeated the Jin army at Nanle and captured their general Sai Xiangyu.

units.zh: 軍元城，晉將李守貞、高行周率兵來逆，破之。
units.en: When the army was at Yuancheng, the Jin generals Li Shouzhen and Gao Xingzhou came out to meet him with their forces, and he put them to rout.
units.literal: The army was at Yuancheng; the Jin generals Li Shouzhen and Gao Xingzhou led troops to oppose him, and he defeated them.

units.zh: 至頓丘，會大霖雨，帝欲班師，延壽諫曰：「晉軍屯河濱，不敢出戰，若徑入澶州，奪其橋，則晉不足平。」
units.en: At Dunqiu a great downpour struck, and the emperor wanted to withdraw. Yanshou urged him, saying, "The Jin forces are camped on the river and dare not come out; if we press straight into Chanzhou and seize their bridge, Jin will not be hard to subdue."
units.literal: At Dunqiu they encountered heavy rains; the emperor wished to withdraw the army. Yanshou remonstrated, saying, "The Jin army is encamped on the riverbank and dares not come out to fight; if we go straight into Chanzhou and seize its bridge, then Jin will not be hard to pacify."

units.zh: 上然之。
units.en: The emperor agreed.
units.literal: The sovereign approved this.

units.zh: 適晉軍先歸澶州，高行周至析城，延壽將輕兵逆戰；
units.en: By then the Jin army had already fallen back to Chanzhou; when Gao Xingzhou reached Xicheng, Yanshou led light troops out to give battle;
units.literal: Just then the Jin army had already returned to Chanzhou; Gao Xingzhou reached Xicheng, and Yanshou led light troops to meet them in battle;

units.zh: 上親督騎士突其陣，敵遂潰。
units.en: the emperor personally directed the cavalry in a charge through their lines, and the enemy broke and fled.
units.literal: the sovereign personally directed the horsemen in a charge through their formation, and the enemy then broke and fled.

units.zh: 師還，留延壽徇貝、冀、深三州。
units.en: On the army's return, Yanshou was left behind to bring the three prefectures of Bei, Ji, and Shen to heel.
units.literal: When the army returned, Yanshou was left to pacify the three prefectures of Bei, Ji, and Shen.

units.zh: 八年，再伐晉，晉主遣延壽族人趙行實以書來招。
units.en: In the eighth year the army marched against Jin again; the Jin ruler sent Yanshou's kinsman Zhao Xingshi with a letter inviting him to defect.
units.literal: In the eighth year they campaigned against Jin again; the Jin sovereign sent Yanshou's clansman Zhao Xingshi with a letter to entice him.

units.zh: 時晉人堅壁不出，延壽紿曰：「我陷虜久，寧忘父母之邦？
units.en: The Jin were holding their walls and refusing battle; Yanshou deceived them, saying, "I have been a captive so long—could I forget the land of my fathers?
units.literal: At the time the Jin held their walls and would not come out; Yanshou deceived them, saying, "I have long been trapped among the captors—how could I forget the land of my parents?

units.zh: 若以軍逆，我即歸。」
units.en: Send an army to meet me and I will come home at once."
units.literal: If you come out with an army to meet me, I will return at once."

units.zh: 晉人以為然，遣杜重威率兵迎之。
units.en: The Jin took him at his word and sent Du Chongwei with an army to welcome him.
units.literal: The Jin believed this and sent Du Chongwei to lead troops to welcome him.

units.zh: 延壽至滹沱河，據中渡橋，與晉軍力戰，手殺其將王清，兩軍相拒。
units.en: Yanshou reached the Hutuo River, seized the Zhongdu Bridge, and fought the Jin army fiercely; he killed their general Wang Qing with his own hand, and the two armies remained locked in stalemate.
units.literal: Yanshou reached the Hutuo River, held the Zhongdu Bridge, and fought the Jin army fiercely; with his own hand he killed their general Wang Qing, and the two armies stood locked against each other.

units.zh: 太宗潛由他渡濟，留延壽與耶律朔古據橋，敵不能奪，屢敗之，杜重威掃厥眾降。
units.en: Taizong secretly crossed at another ford, leaving Yanshou and Yelu Shuogu to hold the bridge; the enemy could not take it, and after repeated defeats Du Chongwei surrendered with his entire force.
units.literal: Taizong secretly crossed by another ford; he left Yanshou and Yelu Shuogu to hold the bridge; the enemy could not seize it, and they repeatedly defeated them until Du Chongwei swept away his whole host and surrendered.

units.zh: 上喜，賜延壽龍鳳赭袍，且曰：「漢兵皆爾所有，爾宜親往撫慰。」
units.en: The emperor was delighted, gave Yanshou a dragon-and-phoenix ochre robe, and said, "All these Han soldiers are yours now; you should go in person to reassure them."
units.literal: The sovereign rejoiced, bestowed on Yanshou a dragon-and-phoenix ochre robe, and said, "All the Han troops are yours; you should go in person to comfort them."

units.zh: 延壽至營，杜重威、李守貞迎謁馬首。
units.en: When Yanshou reached the camp, Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen came out to pay their respects at his stirrup.
units.literal: When Yanshou reached the camp, Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen came out to greet him at his horse's head.

units.zh: 後太宗克汴，延壽因李崧求為皇太子，上曰：「吾於魏王雖割肌肉亦不惜，但皇太子須天子之子得為，魏王豈得為也？」
units.en: After Taizong had conquered Bian, Yanshou used Li Song to ask to be made crown prince. The emperor said, "For the Prince of Wei I would cut away my own flesh without regret, but only a son of the Son of Heaven may be crown prince—how could the Prince of Wei become one?"
units.literal: After Taizong had conquered Bian, Yanshou through Li Song requested to be made crown prince. The sovereign said, "Though for the Prince of Wei I would cut away my own flesh without regret, only a son of the Son of Heaven may be crown prince—how could the Prince of Wei become one?"

units.zh: 蓋上嘗許滅晉後，以中原帝延壽，以故摧堅破敵，延壽常以身先，至是以崧達意。
units.en: The emperor had once promised that after destroying Jin he would make Yanshou emperor of the Central Plains; for that reason he had broken fierce enemies, and Yanshou often took the lead in person—now Li Song conveyed his wish.
units.literal: The sovereign had once promised that after destroying Jin he would make Yanshou emperor of the Central Plains; for this reason he had shattered strong enemies, and Yanshou often led from the front—now Li Song conveyed this wish.

units.zh: 上命遷延壽秩，翰林學士承旨張礪進擬中京留守、大丞相、錄尚書事、都督中外諸軍事，上塗「錄尚書事、都督中外諸軍事」。
units.en: The emperor ordered Yanshou's rank raised. Hanlin Academician Commissioner Zhang Li proposed Central Capital regent, Grand Chancellor, Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Commander-in-Chief of All Military Affairs; the emperor crossed out "Director of the Department of State Affairs, Commander-in-Chief of All Military Affairs."
units.literal: The sovereign ordered Yanshou's rank raised. Hanlin Academician Commissioner Zhang Li proposed Central Capital regent, Grand Chancellor, Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Commander-in-Chief of All Military Affairs; the sovereign crossed out "Director of the Department of State Affairs, Commander-in-Chief of All Military Affairs."

units.zh: 世宗即位，以翊戴功，授樞密使。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong came to the throne, for his merit in supporting the enthronement he was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: When Shizong took the throne, for his merit in supporting the enthronement he was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 天祿二年薨。
units.en: He died in the second year of Tianlu.
units.literal: He died in the second year of Tianlu.

units.zh: 高模翰，一名松，渤海人。
units.en: Gao Mohan, who was also known as Song, came from Bohai.
units.literal: Gao Mohan, also named Song, was a man of Bohai.

units.zh: 有膂力，善騎射，好談兵。
units.en: He was powerfully built, excelled at riding and archery, and loved to talk of military affairs.
units.literal: He had great physical strength, was skilled in horsemanship and archery, and loved to discuss warfare.

units.zh: 初，太祖平渤海，模翰避地高麗，王妻以女。
units.en: When Taizu first pacified Bohai, Mohan fled to Goryeo, where the king gave him a daughter in marriage.
units.literal: At first, when Taizu pacified Bohai, Mohan took refuge in Goryeo and the king gave him a daughter in marriage.

units.zh: 因罪亡歸。
units.en: After committing an offense he fled back home.
units.literal: Because of an offense he fled home.

units.zh: 坐使酒殺人下獄，太祖知其才，貰之。
units.en: He was jailed for killing a man while drunk; Taizu recognized his ability and pardoned him.
units.literal: He was imprisoned for killing a man while drunk; Taizu knew his talent and pardoned him.

units.zh: 天顯十一年七月，唐遣張敬達、楊光遠帥師五十萬攻太原，勢銳甚。
units.en: In the seventh month of the eleventh year of Tianxian, Tang sent Zhang Jingda and Yang Guangyuan at the head of five hundred thousand men against Taiyuan; their advance was fierce.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the eleventh year of Tianxian, Tang sent Zhang Jingda and Yang Guangyuan to command five hundred thousand troops in an attack on Taiyuan; their momentum was very sharp.

units.zh: 石敬瑭遣人求救，太宗許之。
units.en: Shi Jingtang sent envoys to beg for aid, and Taizong agreed.
units.literal: Shi Jingtang sent men to seek rescue; Taizong granted it.

units.zh: 九月，征兵出雁門，模翰與敬達軍接戰，敗之，太原圍解。
units.en: In the ninth month the army was levied and marched out through Yanmen Pass; Mohan engaged Jingda's force, routed it, and the siege of Taiyuan was raised.
units.literal: In the ninth month troops were levied and marched out through Yanmen; Mohan joined battle with Jingda's army, defeated it, and the siege of Taiyuan was lifted.

units.zh: 敬瑭夜出謁帝，約為父子。
units.en: Jingtang came out by night to pay homage to the emperor and agreed to enter a father-and-son bond with him.
units.literal: Jingtang came out by night to pay court to the emperor and agreed to become father and son.

units.zh: 帝召模翰等賜以酒饌，親饗士卒，士氣益振。
units.en: The emperor summoned Mohan and his fellows, gave them wine and food, and personally feasted the troops, and their spirit soared.
units.literal: The emperor summoned Mohan and the others, bestowed wine and food, and personally feasted the soldiers; morale rose all the more.

units.zh: 翌日，復戰，又敗之。
units.en: The next day they fought again and routed them once more.
units.literal: The next day they fought again and defeated them once more.

units.zh: 敬達鼠竄晉安寨，模翰獻俘於帝。
units.en: Jingda scurried like a rat into Jin'an stockade; Mohan presented prisoners to the emperor.
units.literal: Jingda fled like a rat into Jin'an stockade; Mohan presented captives to the emperor.

units.zh: 會敬瑭自立為晉帝，光遠斬敬達以降，諸州悉下。
units.en: When Jingtang declared himself emperor of Jin, Guangyuan killed Jingda and surrendered, and every prefecture fell in line.
units.literal: When Jingtang declared himself emperor of Jin, Guangyuan beheaded Jingda to surrender, and all the prefectures submitted.

units.zh: 上諭模翰曰：「朕自起兵，百餘戰，卿功第一，雖古名將無以加。」
units.en: The emperor told Mohan, "Since I first took up arms, through more than a hundred battles your merit has stood first; not even the great generals of antiquity could surpass it."
units.literal: The sovereign addressed Mohan, saying, "Since I raised the army, in more than a hundred battles your achievement ranks first; even the famous generals of old cannot surpass it."

units.zh: 乃授上將軍。
units.en: He was then appointed General-in-Chief.
units.literal: He was then appointed General-in-Chief.

units.zh: 會同元年，冊禮告成，宴百官及諸國使於二儀殿。
units.en: In the first year of Huitong, when the enthronement rites were complete, he held a banquet for the officials and envoys of the various states in the Hall of the Two Principles.
units.literal: In the first year of Huitong, when the investiture rites were completed, he feasted the hundred officials and envoys of the various states in the Hall of the Two Principles.

units.zh: 帝指模翰曰：「此國之勇將，朕統一天下，斯人之力也。」
units.en: The emperor pointed to Mohan and said, "Here is this state's bravest general; when I brought all under Heaven to heel, it was this man's doing."
units.literal: The emperor pointed to Mohan and said, "This is the valiant general of the state; in my unification of all under Heaven, it is this man's strength."

units.zh: 群臣皆稱萬歲。
units.en: All the ministers shouted "Long live the emperor!"
units.literal: All the ministers cried ten thousand years of life.

units.zh: 及晉叛盟，出師南伐。
units.en: When Jin broke the alliance, the army marched south on campaign.
units.literal: When Jin broke the covenant, the army marched south in campaign.

units.zh: 模翰為統軍副使，與僧遏前驅，拔赤城，破德、貝諸寨。
units.en: Mohan served as deputy army commander; with Senge in the van he captured Chicheng and stormed the stockades at De, Bei, and elsewhere.
units.literal: Mohan served as deputy commander of the army; with Senge as vanguard he took Chicheng and broke the stockades of De, Bei, and others.

units.zh: 是冬，兼總左右鐵鷂子軍，下關南城邑數十。
units.en: That winter he also took command of the left and right Iron Hawk regiments and captured several dozen walled towns south of the pass.
units.literal: That winter he also took overall command of the left and right Iron Hawk units and reduced several tens of walled towns south of the pass.

units.zh: 三月，敕虎官楊覃赴乾寧軍，為滄州節度使田武名所圍，模翰與趙延壽聚議往救。
units.en: In the third month the tiger officer Yang Tan was dispatched to Qianning army, where Cangzhou military governor Tian Wuming besieged him; Mohan and Zhao Yanshou held council and set out to relieve him.
units.literal: In the third month the tiger officer Yang Tan was sent to Qianning army but was besieged by Cangzhou military governor Tian Wuming; Mohan and Zhao Yanshou met in council to go to the rescue.

units.zh: 俄有光自模翰目中出，縈繞旗矛，焰焰如流星久之。
units.en: Suddenly a light shot from Mohan's eyes, wound around the flags and spears, and blazed like a meteor for a long time.
units.literal: Suddenly a light issued from Mohan's eyes, coiled around flags and spears, and blazed like a meteor for a long while.

units.zh: 模翰喜曰：「此天贊之祥！」
units.en: Mohan rejoiced and said, "This is Heaven's blessing upon us!"
units.literal: Mohan rejoiced and said, "This is an omen of Heaven's approval!"

units.zh: 遂進兵，殺獲甚眾。
units.en: He then pressed forward, killing and capturing a great host.
units.literal: He then advanced the army and killed and captured in great numbers.

units.zh: 以功加侍中。
units.en: For his achievements he was further appointed Palace Attendant.
units.literal: For his merit he was additionally made Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 略地鹽山，破饒安，晉人震怖，不敢接戰。
units.en: He overran Yanshan, stormed Rao'an, and the Jin were so terrified they dared not give battle.
units.literal: He overran the territory of Yanshan, broke Rao'an, and the Jin were shaken in terror and dared not join battle.

units.zh: 加太傅。
units.en: He was appointed Grand Tutor.
units.literal: He was made Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 晉以魏府節度使杜重威領兵三十萬來拒，模翰謂左右曰：「軍法在正不在多。
units.en: Jin sent Wei prefecture military governor Du Chongwei with three hundred thousand men to oppose him; Mohan told his attendants, "The art of war rests on justice, not on numbers.
units.literal: Jin sent Wei prefecture military governor Du Chongwei at the head of three hundred thousand troops to resist; Mohan said to those beside him, "The art of war lies in righteousness, not in numbers.

units.zh: 以多陵少，不義必敗。
units.en: To crush the few with the many is unjust and is bound to end in defeat.
units.literal: To use the many to overwhelm the few is unjust and must end in defeat.

units.zh: 其晉之謂乎！」
units.en: Is that not exactly Jin's case!"
units.literal: Is this not what is meant by Jin!"

units.zh: 詰旦，以麾下三百人逆戰，殺其先鋒梁漢璋，餘兵敗走。
units.en: At dawn the next day he met them with three hundred men under his command, killed their vanguard Liang Hanzhang, and the rest broke and fled.
units.literal: At dawn the next day he met them in battle with three hundred men under his command, killed their vanguard Liang Hanzhang, and the rest of the troops were defeated and fled.

units.zh: 手詔褒美，比漢之李陵。
units.en: The emperor wrote him a personal edict of praise, comparing him to Li Ling of Han.
units.literal: An imperial letter in the sovereign's own hand praised him and compared him to Li Ling of Han.

units.zh: 頃之，杜重威等復至滹沱河，帝召模翰問計。
units.en: Before long Du Chongwei and his force were again at the Hutuo River; the emperor summoned Mohan to ask his counsel.
units.literal: Before long Du Chongwei and the others again reached the Hutuo River; the emperor summoned Mohan to ask his plan.

units.zh: 上善其言曰：「諸將莫及此。」
units.en: The emperor approved his plan and said, "None of the other generals can equal this."
units.literal: The sovereign approved his counsel and said, "None of the generals can match this."

units.zh: 乃令模翰守中渡橋。
units.en: He then ordered Mohan to hold the Zhongdu Bridge.
units.literal: He then ordered Mohan to hold the Zhongdu Bridge.

units.zh: 及戰，復敗之，上曰：「朕憑高觀兩軍之勢，顧卿英銳無敵，如鷹逐雉兔。
units.en: In the fighting they routed the enemy again; the emperor said, "From the heights I watched both armies; seeing how fierce and unmatched you were, it was like a hawk chasing pheasant and hare.
units.literal: When battle was joined they defeated them again; the sovereign said, "I watched from a height the momentum of the two armies; looking at you, fierce and unrivaled, it was like a hawk pursuing pheasant and hare.

units.zh: 當圖形麟閣，爵貤後裔。」
units.en: Your portrait belongs in the Qilin Pavilion, and noble rank should descend to your heirs."
units.literal: Your likeness should be painted in the Qilin Pavilion, and noble rank passed down to your descendants."

units.zh: 已而杜重威等降。
units.en: Before long Du Chongwei and his men surrendered.
units.literal: Before long Du Chongwei and the others surrendered.

units.zh: 車駕入汴，加特進檢校太師，封悊郡開國公，賜璽書、劍器。
units.en: When the emperor entered Bian, Mohan was further made Special Advancement and Acting Grand Preceptor, enfeoffed as Duke of the Ti Commandery state, and given an imperial letter and ceremonial sword.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage entered Bian, Mohan was additionally made Special Advancement and Acting Grand Preceptor, enfeoffed as Duke of the Ti Commandery state, and bestowed an imperial letter and sword regalia.

units.zh: 為汴州巡檢使，平汜水諸山土賊，遷鎮中京。
units.en: He served as inspection commissioner of Bianzhou, pacified the mountain bandits around Sishui, and was transferred to garrison the Central Capital.
units.literal: He served as inspection commissioner of Bianzhou, pacified the mountain bandits of Sishui and the region, and was transferred to garrison the Central Capital.

units.zh: 天祿二年，加開府儀同三司，賜對衣、鞍勒、名馬。
units.en: In the second year of Tianlu he was further appointed Honored Companion with the Three Excellencies and given matching robes, saddle and bridle, and a fine horse.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianlu he was additionally made Honored Companion with the Three Excellencies and bestowed matching robes, saddle and bridle, and a famous horse.

units.zh: 應歷初，召為中臺省右相。
units.en: At the start of the Yingli era he was summoned to serve as Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yingli he was summoned to be Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

units.zh: 至東京，父老歡迎曰：「公起戎行，致身富貴，為鄉里榮，相如、買臣輩不足過也。」
units.en: When he reached the Eastern Capital, the local elders welcomed him, saying, "You rose from the ranks to wealth and honor and have brought glory to our home—men like Sima Xiangru and Zhu Maichen are not your equal."
units.literal: When he reached the Eastern Capital, the elders welcomed him, saying, "Sir, you rose from the army to attain wealth and rank, bringing glory to your home district—men like Xiangru and Maichen cannot surpass you."

units.zh: 九年正月，遷左相，卒。
units.en: In the first month of the ninth year he was moved to Left Chancellor and died.
units.literal: In the first month of the ninth year he was transferred to Left Chancellor and died.

units.zh: 趙思溫，字文美，盧龍人。
units.en: Zhao Siwen, whose courtesy name was Wenmei, came from Lulong.
units.literal: Zhao Siwen, courtesy name Wenmei, was a man of Lulong.

units.zh: 少果銳，膂力兼人，隸燕帥劉仁恭幕。
units.en: As a youth he was bold and keen, possessed the strength of several men, and served on the staff of the Yan commander Liu Rengong.
units.literal: In youth he was resolute and sharp, his strength the equal of several men, and he served on the staff of Yan commander Liu Rengong.

units.zh: 李存勖問罪於燕，思溫統偏師拒之。
units.en: When Li Cunxu marched against Yan, Siwen led a detached force to hold him off.
units.literal: Li Cunxu called Yan to account; Siwen commanded a detached force to resist him.

units.zh: 流矢中目，裂裳漬血，戰猶不已。
units.en: A stray arrow struck his eye; he tore his robe to staunch the blood and still would not stop fighting.
units.literal: A stray arrow struck his eye; he tore his robe to soak the blood and still did not cease fighting.

units.zh: 為存勖將周德威所擒，存勖壯而釋其縛。
units.en: Cunxu's general Zhou Dewei captured him; impressed by his spirit, Cunxu had his bonds cut.
units.literal: He was captured by Cunxu's general Zhou Dewei; Cunxu admired his spirit and released his bonds.

units.zh: 久之，日見信用。
units.en: In time he won greater trust each day.
units.literal: After a long while he came to be trusted day by day.

units.zh: 與梁戰於莘縣，以驍勇聞，授平州刺史，兼平、營、薊三州都指揮使。
units.en: He fought the Liang at Shen county and won fame for fierce courage; he was made prefect of Pingzhou and overall commander of Ping, Ying, and Ji.
units.literal: He fought Liang at Shen county and became known for fierce valor; he was appointed prefect of Pingzhou and concurrently overall commander of Ping, Ying, and Ji prefectures.

units.zh: 神冊二年，太祖遣大將經略燕地，思溫來降。
units.en: In the second year of Shence, when Taizu sent a great general to take charge of the Yan region, Siwen came over to surrender.
units.literal: In the second year of Shence, Taizu sent a great general to oversee the Yan region; Siwen came to surrender.

units.zh: 及伐渤海，以思溫為漢軍都團練使，力戰，拔扶餘城。
units.en: In the campaign against Bohai he was made overall regimental commissioner of the Han forces; he fought hard and captured Fuyu.
units.literal: When they campaigned against Bohai, Siwen was made overall regimental commissioner of the Han army; he fought fiercely and took Fuyu city.

units.zh: 身被數創，太祖親為調藥。
units.en: He was wounded several times, and Taizu personally prepared medicine for him.
units.literal: His body received several wounds; Taizu personally prepared medicine for him.

units.zh: 太宗即位，以功擢檢校太保、保靜軍節度使。
units.en: When Taizong came to the throne, Siwen was promoted for his achievements to Acting Grand Guardian and military governor of the Baojing army.
units.literal: When Taizong took the throne, for his merit Siwen was promoted to Acting Grand Guardian and military governor of the Baojing army.

units.zh: 天顯十一年，唐兵攻太原，石敬瑭遣使求救，上命思溫自嵐、憲間出兵援之。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Tianxian, when Tang attacked Taiyuan, Shi Jingtang sent envoys begging for aid; the emperor ordered Siwen to march out through Lan and Xian to relieve the city.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Tianxian, Tang troops attacked Taiyuan; Shi Jingtang sent envoys to seek rescue, and the sovereign ordered Siwen to march out between Lan and Xian to relieve him.

units.zh: 既罷兵，改南京留守、盧龍軍節度使、管內觀察處置等使、開府儀同三司，兼侍中，賜協謀靜亂翊聖功臣，尋改臨海軍節度使。
units.en: When the campaign ended he became regent of the Southern Capital, military governor of Lulong, commissioner for observation and disposition within the circuit, Honored Companion with the Three Excellencies, and concurrent Palace Attendant, and was granted the title Merit Lord Who Conspires in Counsel, Pacifies Disorder, and Assists the Sage; soon after he was transferred to military governor of the Linhai army.
units.literal: After the army was dismissed, he was made regent of the Southern Capital, military governor of the Lulong army, commissioner for observation and disposition within the circuit, Honored Companion with the Three Excellencies, and concurrently Palace Attendant, and was granted the title of Merit Lord Who Conspires in Counsel, Pacifies Disorder, and Assists the Sage; shortly thereafter he was changed to military governor of the Linhai army.

units.zh: 會同初，從耶律牒摐使晉行冊禮，還，加檢校太師。
units.en: Early in the Huitong era he accompanied Yelu Diezeng to Jin on the investiture mission; on his return he was further appointed Acting Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huitong he followed Yelu Diezeng as envoy to Jin to perform the investiture rites; on his return he was additionally made Acting Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 二年，有星隕於庭，卒。
units.en: In the second year a meteor fell in his courtyard, and he died.
units.literal: In the second year a star fell in his courtyard and he died.

units.zh: 上遣使賻祭，贈太師、魏國公。
units.en: The emperor sent envoys with funeral gifts and sacrifices and posthumously enfeoffed him Grand Preceptor and Duke of Wei.
units.literal: The sovereign sent envoys with funeral gifts and sacrifices and posthumously enfeoffed him as Grand Preceptor and Duke of Wei.

units.zh: 子延照、延靖，官至使相。
units.en: His sons Yanzhao and Yanjing both rose to the rank of commissioner-chancellor.
units.literal: His sons Yanzhao and Yanjing rose to the rank of commissioner-chancellor.

units.zh: 耶律漚裏思，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。
units.en: Yelu Oulisi was descended from Puguzhi, yilijin of the Six Courts.
units.literal: Yelu Oulisi was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilijin of the Six Courts.

units.zh: 負勇略，每戰被重鎧，揮鐵槊，所向披靡。
units.en: Bold and resourceful in war, he always wore heavy armor, swung an iron spear, and swept everything before him.
units.literal: He possessed courage and strategy; in every battle he wore heavy armor, wielded an iron spear, and swept all before him.

units.zh: 會同間，伐晉，上至河而獵，適海東青鶻搏雉，晉人隔水以鴿引去。
units.en: During the Huitong campaign against Jin, the emperor went hunting by the river; a eastern-sea green falcon had just struck a pheasant when Jin men across the water lured it away with a homing pigeon.
units.literal: During Huitong, in the campaign against Jin, the sovereign went to the river to hunt; just then a eastern-sea green falcon struck a pheasant, and the Jin across the water lured it away with a pigeon.

units.zh: 上顧左右曰：「誰為我得此人？」
units.en: The emperor turned to his attendants and said, "Who will bring that man to me?"
units.literal: The sovereign looked to those beside him and said, "Who will get this man for me?"

units.zh: 漚裏思請內廄馬，濟河擒之，並殺救者數人還。
units.en: Oulisi asked for a horse from the imperial stables, crossed the river and captured the man, killed several rescuers, and returned.
units.literal: Oulisi requested a horse from the inner stables, crossed the river and seized him, and also killed several of those who came to the rescue before returning.

units.zh: 上大悅，優加賞賚。
units.en: The emperor was delighted and rewarded him handsomely.
units.literal: The sovereign was greatly pleased and bestowed rewards upon him in exceptional measure.

units.zh: 既而晉將杜重威逆於望都，據水勒戰。
units.en: Soon afterward the Jin general Du Chongwei met them at Wangdu, holding the river line and forcing a fight.
units.literal: Before long the Jin general Du Chongwei opposed them at Wangdu, holding the water and forcing battle.

units.zh: 漚裏思介馬突陣，余軍繼之。
units.en: Oulisi spurred his horse through the enemy line, and the rest of the army followed.
units.literal: Oulisi spurred his horse and charged the formation; the rest of the army followed.

units.zh: 被圍，眾言陣薄處可出，漚裏思曰：「恐彼有他備。」
units.en: Surrounded, his men said they could break out where the enemy line was thin; Oulisi said, "They may have another trap there."
units.literal: When they were surrounded, the troops said a thin place in the formation offered escape; Oulisi said, "I fear the enemy has another preparation there."

units.zh: 竟引兵沖堅而出；
units.en: In the end he led his men in a charge straight through the strongest point of the line and broke out;
units.literal: In the end he led his troops in a charge through the solid center and broke out;

units.zh: 回視眾所指，皆大塹也。
units.en: and when he looked back at the spot his men had indicated, it was nothing but deep trenches.
units.literal: looking back at where the troops had pointed, there were all great trenches.

units.zh: 其料敵多此類。
units.en: His judgment of the enemy was often of this sort.
units.literal: His reading of the enemy was often of this kind.

units.zh: 是年，總領敵烈皮室軍，坐私免部曲，奪官，卒。
units.en: That year he took command of the Dilie pishi army; for privately dismissing men from his command he was stripped of rank and died.
units.literal: That year he took overall command of the Dilie pishi army; for privately dismissing troops from his command he was stripped of office and died.

units.zh: 張礪，磁州人，初仕唐為掌書記，遷翰林學士。
units.en: Zhang Li came from Cizhou; he first served Tang as a secretarial aide and was later promoted to Hanlin academician.
units.literal: Zhang Li, a man of Cizhou, at first served Tang as secretarial aide and was promoted to Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 會石敬瑭起兵，唐主以礪為招討判官，從趙德鈞援張敬達於河東。
units.en: When Shi Jingtang rebelled, the Tang ruler made Li judge on the pacification campaign and sent him with Zhao Dejun to relieve Zhang Jingda in Hedong.
units.literal: When Shi Jingtang raised troops, the Tang sovereign made Li pacification campaign judge and had him follow Zhao Dejun to relieve Zhang Jingda in Hedong.

units.zh: 及敬達敗，礪入契丹。
units.en: After Jingda was defeated, Li went over to the Khitan.
units.literal: When Jingda was defeated, Li entered Khitan territory.

units.zh: 後太宗見礪剛直有文彩，擢翰林學士。
units.en: Later Taizong saw that Li was upright and gifted with letters and appointed him Hanlin academician.
units.literal: Later Taizong saw that Li was upright and possessed literary talent and promoted him to Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 礪臨事必盡言，無所避，上益重之。
units.en: In office Li always spoke his mind fully and held nothing back, and the emperor came to esteem him all the more.
units.literal: In office Li always spoke his full mind without evasion, and the sovereign valued him all the more.

units.zh: 未幾，謀亡歸，為追騎所獲。
units.en: Before long he plotted to escape home and was caught by pursuing horsemen.
units.literal: Before long he plotted to flee home and was captured by pursuing horsemen.

units.zh: 上責曰：「汝何故亡？」
units.en: The emperor rebuked him: "Why did you run away?"
units.literal: The sovereign rebuked him, saying, "Why did you flee?"

units.zh: 礪對曰：「臣不習北方土俗，飲食居處，意常郁郁，以是亡耳。」
units.en: Li answered, "I am not used to northern ways of eating, drinking, and living; I have been miserable—that is why I fled."
units.literal: Li replied, "Your servant is not accustomed to northern customs in food, drink, and dwelling; my mind is often depressed—that is why I fled."

units.zh: 上顧通事高彥英曰：「朕嘗戒汝善遇此人，何乃使失所而亡？
units.en: The emperor turned to the interpreter Gao Yanying and said, "I told you to treat this man well—how could you drive him to flee?
units.literal: The sovereign turned to the interpreter Gao Yanying and said, "I once warned you to treat this man well—how could you let him lose his place and flee?

units.zh: 礪去，可再得耶？」
units.en: If Li were lost, could we ever get him back?"
units.literal: If Li were gone, could he be obtained again?"

units.zh: 遂杖彥英而謝礪。
units.en: He had Yanying beaten and apologized to Li.
units.literal: He then had Yanying beaten with the staff and apologized to Li.

units.zh: 會同初，升翰林承旨，兼吏部尚書，從太宗伐晉。
units.en: Early in Huitong he was promoted to Hanlin commissioner and concurrent Minister of Personnel, and accompanied Taizong on the campaign against Jin.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huitong he was promoted to Hanlin commissioner and concurrently made Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, and followed Taizong in the campaign against Jin.

units.zh: 入汴，諸將蕭翰、耶律郎五、麻答輩肆殺掠，礪奏曰：「今大遼始得中國，宜以中國人治之，不可專用國人及左右近習。
units.en: After entering Bian, generals such as Xiao Han, Yelu Langwu, and Mada killed and plundered at will; Li memorialized, "Great Liao has only just won China; it should be governed by Chinese, not entrusted solely to Khitan and personal favorites.
units.literal: On entering Bian, the generals Xiao Han, Yelu Langwu, Mada, and their like wantonly killed and plundered; Li memorialized, saying, "Great Liao has only now obtained China; it should be governed by Chinese, and one must not rely solely on countrymen and close attendants.

units.zh: 茍政令乖失，則人心不服，雖得之亦將失之。」
units.en: If policy goes wrong, the people will not submit; even having won the realm, you will lose it again."
units.literal: If policies and commands go astray, hearts will not submit; though you have gained it, you will yet lose it."

units.zh: 上不聽。
units.en: The emperor would not listen.
units.literal: The sovereign did not heed this.

units.zh: 改右僕射，兼門下侍郎、平章事。
units.en: He was made Right Vice Director and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor.
units.literal: He was changed to Right Vice Director and concurrently made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 頃之，車駕北還，至欒城崩。
units.en: Before long the emperor headed north; at Luancheng he died.
units.literal: Before long the imperial carriage returned north; at Luancheng the sovereign died.

units.zh: 時礪在恒州，蕭翰與麻答以兵圍其第。
units.en: Li was then at Hengzhou; Xiao Han and Mada surrounded his house with soldiers.
units.literal: At the time Li was at Hengzhou; Xiao Han and Mada surrounded his residence with troops.

units.zh: 礪方臥病，出見之。
units.en: Li was bedridden with illness but came out to meet them.
units.literal: Li was lying ill but came out to see them.

units.zh: 翰數之曰：「汝何故於先帝言國人不可為節度使？
units.en: Han rebuked him: "Why did you tell the late emperor that Khitan must not be made military governors?
units.literal: Han reproached him, saying, "Why did you tell the late emperor that countrymen must not be made military governors?

units.zh: 我以國舅之親，有征伐功，先帝留我守汴，以為宣武軍節度使，汝獨以為不可。
units.en: As the emperor's uncle by marriage, with campaign merit, I was left by the late emperor to hold Bian as military governor of the Xuanwu army—you alone said I could not.
units.literal: I, by kinship as imperial uncle-in-law and merit in campaigns, was left by the late emperor to guard Bian and made military governor of the Xuanwu army—you alone said it could not be done.

units.zh: 又譖我與解裏好掠人財物子女。
units.en: You also slandered me and Jieli as men who loved to seize people's goods and daughters.
units.literal: You also slandered me and Jieli as fond of seizing people's goods and daughters.

units.zh: 今必殺汝！」
units.en: Today I will kill you!"
units.literal: Today I will certainly kill you!"

units.zh: 趣令鎖之。
units.en: He ordered him bound at once.
units.literal: He hurriedly ordered him bound.

units.zh: 礪抗聲曰：「此國家大體，安危所系，吾實言之。
units.en: Li answered boldly, "This touches the fundamental order of the state and its safety—I spoke the truth.
units.literal: Li answered in a defiant voice, "This concerns the great principle of the state and what binds security and peril—I spoke the truth.

units.zh: 欲殺即殺，奚以鎖為？」
units.en: Kill me if you will—why bother to bind me?"
units.literal: If you wish to kill, then kill—why bind me?"

units.zh: 麻答以礪大臣，不可專殺，乃救止之。
units.en: Mada argued that Li was a senior minister and could not be killed on private authority, and held Han back.
units.literal: Mada, because Li was a great minister and could not be killed on one's own authority, restrained him and stopped it.

units.zh: 是夕，礪恚憤卒。
units.en: That night Li died of grief and anger.
units.literal: That evening Li died of indignation and rage.

units.zh: 論曰：初，晉因遼之兵而得天下，故兼臣禮而父事之，割地以為壽，輸帛以為貢。
units.en: The commentary says: At first Jin had won the realm with Liao's armies, and so treated Liao both as lord and as father, ceding land as a birthday gift and sending silk as tribute.
units.literal: The commentary says: At first Jin obtained the realm through Liao's troops; therefore it observed both ministerial rites and served Liao as a father, ceding territory as a gift of longevity and sending silk as tribute.

units.zh: 未久也，而會同之師次滹沱矣。
units.en: Before long the Huitong army was camped on the Hutuo.
units.literal: It was not long before the Huitong army halted at the Hutuo.

units.zh: 豈群帥貪功黷武而致然歟？
units.en: Was it because the commanders were greedy for glory and addicted to war?
units.literal: Was it because the commanders were greedy for merit and addicted to warfare that this came about?

units.zh: 抑所謂信不由衷也哉？
units.en: Or was it simply that their loyalty was never sincere?
units.literal: Or was it rather what is called faith not proceeding from the heart?

units.zh: 模翰以功名自終，可謂良將。
units.en: Mohan died with his reputation intact and may truly be called a fine general.
units.literal: Mohan ended his life in merit and fame and may be called a good general.

units.zh: 若延壽之勛雖著，至於覬覦儲位，謬矣，利令智昏，固無足議。
units.en: Yanshou's achievements were great, but in coveting the heir's throne he was deluded; gain had blinded his judgment, and he is hardly worth debating.
units.literal: As for Yanshou, though his achievements were notable, in coveting the heir's position he erred; profit makes wisdom dim—there is truly nothing worth discussing.

units.zh: 若乃成末釁以虧俊功，如解裏者，何譏焉！
units.en: As for those who let a late misstep spoil splendid service, like Jieli—what reproach is there to make!
units.literal: As for one who brings final trouble to ruin outstanding merit, like Jieli—what is there to reproach!
